I'm 70 years old, been farming this land since I was 20. My old man taught me, and I've seen good years and bad years. I only went to primary school, so I don't read those technical papers — I watch what works on my own fields and what the neighbors do. My farm is just 4.1 mu, me and my wife run it. We're old now, so we can't do heavy labor like we used to, and we hire help sometimes for harvest. Money is tight. We live off this land and a bit of pension, so every yuan I spend on inputs I think about three times.

**Winter wheat:** I plant wheat on all 4.1 mu in early October, same as always. I use my own saved seed — why buy new when mine sprouts fine? Costs me almost nothing, maybe 20 yuan/mu if I count cleaning it. For fertilizer, I put down about 40 jin of compound fertilizer per mu before planting as base, then at green-up in spring if the wheat looks yellow I topdress with another 20-30 jin of urea per mu. I can't afford those fancy rates. Last year I did about this much and got around 380 jin per mu, so I'll do the same. I irrigate three times: once before winter to help it survive the cold, once at jointing in spring, and once at flowering if it doesn't rain. Pumping costs money — electricity for the well — so I don't over-water. One herbicide spray in spring for weeds. I rotary till before planting. Me and my wife handle most of it, but for harvest in June I might hire a combine for half a day — that's about 50 yuan/mu.

**Summer maize:** After wheat harvest in mid-June, I have maybe 5-7 days to get maize in the ground. I buy hybrid seed from the shop — saved maize seed doesn't grow well. Costs about 35 yuan/mu. I put down compound fertilizer at planting, roughly 50 jin per mu. If the rains are good I might not topdress, but if it stays dry and the leaves turn yellow at big-flare stage, I'll add a bit of urea. I irrigate once or twice — right after planting if it's dry, and maybe at tasseling if there's no rain. One round of herbicide. We plant by hand or with the small planter, harvest by hand or hire a machine. I expect about 400 jin per mu if the weather cooperates, but last year was closer to 350 because of dry spell in August.

I thought about buying more fertilizer, but at my age, with only 4.1 mu, the extra yield wouldn't pay for itself fast enough. Better to keep some cash for medicine and daily needs. I stick with what I know.
